title: The Market at Hollywood Studios | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Market Located in Pixar Plaza at Disney's Hollywood Studios Take a break but keep the fun going with snacks like Num Num Cookies, chips and fresh fruit—and quench your thirst with refreshing frozen cocktails, cold beer or soft drinks.View Menu American Snack Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM Valid admission required.
